import re
import subprocess
from functools import lru_cache
from typing import Any, Callable, TypeVar

T = TypeVar("T")
PATTERN = re.compile(r"^(?P<name>[a-z_]+)\s*=\s*(?P<value>.+)$", re.MULTILINE)


def retry(times: int = 3) -> Callable[[Callable[..., T]], Callable[..., T]]:
    def wrap(fn: Callable[..., T]) -> Callable[..., T]:
        def inner(*args: Any, **kwargs: Any) -> T:
            last: Exception | None = None
            for attempt in range(times):
                try:
                    return fn(*args, **kwargs)
                except (OSError, ValueError) as exc:
                    last = exc
            raise RuntimeError("gave up") from last

        return inner

    return wrap


@lru_cache(maxsize=None)
def fib(n: int) -> int:
    return n if n < 2 else fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)


@retry(times=5)
def git(*args: str, cwd: str = ".") -> str:
    out = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, check=True)
    return out.stdout.strip()

flags = 0b1010 | 0x0F & ~0o7
matrix = [[1, 2], [3, 4]]
result = matrix @ matrix if hasattr(matrix, "__matmul__") else None

line two"""
x = 1 if name else -1

assert fib(10) == 55, "fib is broken"
global_count: int = 0

    x += 1
    if x > 3:
        break
    elif x == 2:
        continue
    else:
        pass

match command.split():
    case ["go", direction]:
        print(direction)
    case ["quit" | "exit"]:
        raise SystemExit(0)
    case _:
        print("unknown")


class Node(Base, metaclass=Meta):
    __slots__ = ("value", "children")

    def __init__(self, value: int, children: list["Node"] | None = None) -> None:
        super().__init__()
        self.value = value
        self.children = children or []

    def __eq__(self, other: object) -> bool:
        return isinstance(other, Node) and self.value == other.value

    @staticmethod
    def leaf(value: int) -> "Node":
        return Node(value)

    async def walk(self):
        yield self
        for child in self.children:
            async for node in child.walk():
                yield node


try:
    with open("x.txt") as f, open("y.txt", "w") as g:
        g.write(f.read())
except FileNotFoundError:
    print(None, True, False, Ellipsis, ...)
finally:
    print("done")
